Chosen.note: Two triggers carrying real chosen values, chevron muted and flush right, labels and helper in the right type roles.

Placeholder.note: Unset trigger renders the placeholder in muted via data-placeholder, so it is clearly distinct from a chosen value.

Open.note: Renders open statically with position="popper": menu sits below the trigger, both groups with their SelectLabels, the separator, the disabled option at reduced opacity and the check on the current value.

States.note: aria-invalid on the trigger gives a destructive border with a destructive line; the disabled trigger fades at 50% and keeps its value readable.
